$description: Hand-authored semantic glass fills. Translucent oklch surfaces with alpha, 8-tier system from near-opaque to heavy accent tint. Consumed by the `surface` named-preset file.

glass.$description: Glass surface fills — translucent with alpha. 8-tier system from near-opaque to transparent.

deep.$description: Heavy glass — overlays, inputs, chat panels.

standard.$description: Default glass — most common container treatment.

blue.$description: Blue-tinted glass — connect / CTA-adjacent panels. Hue 240 matches brand blue (locked requirement #6). H-rotation sibling of teal/purple at the same L/alpha band (S1.C surface diversification).

ember.$description: Ember-tinted glass — warm accent panels. Hue 25 matches the ember brand ramp. H-rotation sibling of teal/purple (S1.C surface diversification).

coral.$description: Coral-tinted glass — voice / warm accent panels. Hue 10 matches the brand-coral ramp. H-rotation sibling of teal/purple (S1.C surface diversification).
